recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-23786; any future neighboring ValueSet extension work should remain tied to its own FHIR-core or FHIR-extensions tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-23786 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Vocabulary request for R5 to remove the valueset-system extension because it duplicated ValueSet.compose.include.system and added no semantics.
initial_application: No core commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-23786 was found. R5 ValueSet work in 054eabf311 left the extension present as retired, and dd468d4f17 later removed it from core by deleting source/valueset/structuredefinition-extension-valueset-system.xml and removing the StructureDefinition/valueset-system ValueSet implementation-guide reference.
additional_context: The 2020 Vocab block-vote announcement and minutes record FHIR-23786 as persuasive and accepted. A later FHIR-extensions issue, FHIR-40714, independently removed the same extension from the Extension Pack; current extension-pack source only has the distinct valueset-systemName extension. The remaining exact core hit is the historical OID mapping in source/oids.ini.
reconciliation: No source change was made. ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini, the ValueSet core implementation guide no longer lists the removed extension, and ValueSet.compose.include.system remains the native resource element that carries the intended semantics.
